descriptionChirho: The proper masculine name Agag (Hebrew אֲגָג), the Amalekite king defeated by Saul and executed by Samuel (1 Samuel 15), also referenced in Balaam's oracle (Numbers 24:7). All 8 occurrences refer to the same royal figure with only prepositional variation. Translations are uniformly consistent: eng 'Agag', spa 'Agag', hin अगग / अगाग, arb أَجَاج, kor 아각, swa 'Agagi'. The comparative form (S79843 'above/than Agag') is syntactic, not semantic.
